title: Photo: hand holding a lit candle
summary: The same photograph as the previous slide, now with the candle lit: a hand holds the tall, thin candle with a bright flame on its wick, casting a shadow on the wall. No words on the slide.

pictures.description: Close photograph of a man's hand gripping a slender multi-coloured taper candle whose wick is now burning with a small bright flame. The warm light glows on the plain wall behind, and the hand and candle cast a shadow.
